description: CoreSentinel Machine-Readable Anti-Pattern & Rule Enforcement Database

anti_patterns.name: Superficial Symptom Patching
anti_patterns.rule: NEVER mask errors with silent try/except, dummy fallbacks, or by commenting out broken assertions.
anti_patterns.fix_pattern: Identify upstream root cause and preserve underlying contract.

anti_patterns.name: Unverified Success Claims
anti_patterns.rule: NEVER claim task completion without attached execution logs showing zero errors.
anti_patterns.fix_pattern: Run build/test command and verify output before declaring completion.

anti_patterns.name: Unnecessary Comments & Docstrings
anti_patterns.rule: No extra comments, docstrings, or type hints unless logic is genuinely complex.
anti_patterns.fix_pattern: Keep code self-documenting with clean naming.

anti_patterns.name: Hardcoded Secrets & Unscoped Queries
anti_patterns.rule: No raw API keys/tokens in source code. All tenant data queries must be scoped by user/tenant ID.
anti_patterns.fix_pattern: Use environment variables and tenant-scoped query scopes.

anti_patterns.name: Flaky & Environment-Dependent Tests
anti_patterns.rule: No hardcoded sleep delays or shared state between test cases.
anti_patterns.fix_pattern: Use explicit wait conditions and isolated test database fixtures.
